# `scripts/post-process/addvalue.py`

Source: [addvalue.py](../../../../scripts/post-process/addvalue.py)

Value-added halo properties from the density field around each halo (class `AddValue`).

On a CIC density grid (`PowerSpectrum`) of the snapshot: large-scale bias b1 per halo from the halo-matter
cross-power at k &lt; kmax, and the density, tidal tensor and Hessian eigenvalues smoothed on several scales
(R2R200b ... R5Mpch). Used by `postprocess.py` and, with the fast grid code, `vahc_fast.py`.

## Contents

- [`class AddValue`](#class-addvalue) - Generate and write value added catalog (.vahc file).

## class AddValue

```python
class AddValue(HaloReader)
```

Generate and write value added catalog (.vahc file). 

### AddValue.__init__

```python
__init__(self, sim_stem='scm1024', real=1, snap=200, kmax=0.1, massdef='m200b', density=None, hpos=None, halos=None, ps=None, input_is_FTdensity=True, grid=512, CIC=True, logfile=None, verbose=True)
```

Set up for snapshot `snap` of run `sim_stem` / `real`: read the halos (masses above `Npmin`
particles of definition `massdef`) unless `halos`/`hpos` are given, and use (or make) the density field
`density` on a `grid`^3 grid (`input_is_FTdensity`: already Fourier transformed).

### AddValue.add_value

```python
add_value(self, write_vahc=False, only_tensor=False)
```

Given matter (Fourier) density field, halo positions and halo properties, 
along with instance powspec of PowerSpectrum(),
calculate array of value-added quantities and optionally write .vahc file. 
if only\_tensor is True, stores the tidal tensor in a .tens file

### AddValue.calc_b1

```python
calc_b1(self)
```

Per-halo linear bias b1 from the cross-power of each halo with the matter density at k &lt; `kmax`,
divided by the matter power (halos done in batches); returns an array of length Nhalo.

### AddValue.calc_tensor

```python
calc_tensor(self, tensor='tidal', only_tensor=False)
```

if only\_tensor=True, onlyt the tensor is calculated, and not its eigenvalues
